The '''Vvaw system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Calaron sector/Legends|Calaron sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vvaw/Legends|Vvaw]].
